  by_contra hx

    real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx)
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let v n : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u n, hB n⟩
  let f n := (v n, v (n + 1), v (n + 2), v (n + 3))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := Finite.wellQuasiOrdered Eq f
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hij.le.dest
  refine ⟨i, c, Nat.lt_of_add_lt_add_left hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  suffices f (n + c) = f n from congrArg (·.1.1) this
  refine Nat.le_induction heq.symm ?_ n hn
  intro n hn ih
  simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.ext_iff, v, Nat.succ_add] at ih ⊢
  simp only [ih, true_and, ← Int.cast_inj (α := ℝ),
    fun n => (hu (n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left ..)).1,
    Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, Nat.sub_zero]

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j := electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t
  have hEd j k := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A
    hA3
  have hBt j := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB (j, i)) x t
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    hJd x i t
  have hBs := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ => hBt j
  have hsum : ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x = _ :=
    congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x)
      (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  simp only [Space.deriv_eq i,
    fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt, div_eq_mul_inv,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t).differentiableAt,
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hsum
  simp only [← Space.deriv_eq] at hsum
  conv_lhs at hsum =>
    enter [2, j]
    rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      hA3.of_succ x) s,
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  simp only [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub (hBs.const_mul _) (hJt.const_mul _),
    fderiv_const_mul hBs,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt,
    fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, _root_.sum_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq,
    Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
    (hB _),
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ hA3.of_succ,
    Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i _) (hEd _ i), Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, hsum, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀, div_eq_mul_inv,
    mul_inv_rev, one_mul, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P f F c Q y
  let E := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let O := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
  dsimp only [F, fold, f]
  simp only [P, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add,
    Polynomial.eval_mul, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h]
  trans (1 - r_chal) * E.eval y.val + r_chal * O.eval y.val
  ·
    simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y, Fin2ToF2,
      one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    ring
  ·
    simp only [Q, c, intermediateEvaluationPoly, E, O, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul,
      add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let t := ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF (𝓕 := 𝓕)
  let m := LinearMap.mul ℂ 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra
  have e : (m.comp (LinearMap.mulRight ℂ c)).compr₂ₛₗ t =
      m.compr₂ₛₗ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℂ (ι c) ∘ₗ t) := by
    refine ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs' => ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs => ?_
    dsimp [m, t]
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, c]
    let p c := crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ
    let sorted := (φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel
    let l1 := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        sorted) ++
      (List.filter p φs')
    let l2 := (List.filter p φs) ++
      (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        sorted)
    have hs l
        (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, p c) :
        crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs) = l1 ++ l ++ l2 := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs hl]
      apply List.append_assoc
    trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι c * ι (ofCrAnListF l2))
    ·
      dsimp only [c]
      rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
      simp only [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.singleton_append,
        timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      rw [hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [p, hφψ, hψφ]), hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [p, hφψ, hψφ])]
      simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
      rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub, smul_comm]
    have h0 := hs [] (by simp)
    simp only [List.append_nil] at h0
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
      mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← h0]
    by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq,
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f a b) e
